row.title: Promotion is part of every tenant's role; Unlearn promotes itself
row.body: TENANT-PROMO-1 (Rowan 2026-11-22). Unlearn serves /social-queue.json (one belief every 2 days from 2026-11-23, built by the shared seed/worker/src/promoqueue.js), listed in social/gate.json tenant_queues and drained by the core publisher, which now takes tenants in turn (fairOrder). Unlearn is a live showcase on ultrastable.io and every Unlearn page links its live siblings from doctrine/stakeholders.json. foundation/tenantpromo.py --check (in checks) fails any system in progress.json that does not promote itself. Practical Solutions linking Unlearn from its own pages is a change in ultrastable/practical-solutions; it is cross-promoted from ultrastable.io and from Unlearn meanwhile.
